Bonus: Vanilla

My go-to spices and herbs are (apart from the obvious ones, such as salt and pepper):

  • Rosemary - Great for lamb and pork dishes.
  • Cayenne pepper - I use this for a simple sharp heat if I don't want to go through the trouble of using fresh peppers, for example.
  • Thyme - Once again, great for lamb and pork, but also for beef stews.
  • Tarragon - I tend to do sauce Bearnaise sometimes, but this can also be used with poultry dishes.
  • Saffron - Great for risottos or pasta sauces.
  • Cinnamon sticks - I use this mostly for desserts. Try adding a stick to your pannacotta when boiling it for example!
  • Vanilla - Once again, mostly used for desserts. Don't skimp out and buy vanillin powder; get some of the real stuff (dried vanilla roots)
  • Star anise - This is great for adding depth to simple dishes. I always add one nowadays when I boil some jasmine rice, or fry minced meat.
  • Cumin - A must-have to cook indian dishes. I also use this whenever I cook mexican food.
  • Coriander - I use this also for indian, asian and mexican dishes.
